title: Early Closure Fee Charge — Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service Rate Note
content:
**Charge clause.** An early closure fee on the Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service is charged only for a closure dated fewer than the tier's minimum term, in whole months, after the service's enrolled date, whole months between two dates being the difference in calendar months between them, less one when the later date's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's; a later closure is charged nothing. The early closure fee is the early closure fee of the tier the service holds, rounded half up to the cent.

**Assembly clause.** The fee so measured is reduced once by the sum of every percentage relief that applies to the closure, the percentages being added together into one rate rather than applied one after another, and the reduced fee is never below zero; the result is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end, and a fee that comes to zero is not debited.

The minimum term and the early closure fee are the figures of the tier the service holds; the enrolled date is the date on the service record on which the employer enrolled.

## Within the minimum term or not (hypothetical dates, a 12-month minimum term)

| Enrolled | Closing date | Whole months | Charged |
|---|---|---|---|
| the 12th of a month | the 11th, twelve calendar months later | 11 | yes |
| the 12th of a month | the 12th, twelve calendar months later | 12 | nothing |
| the 12th of a month | the 30th, eleven calendar months later | 11 | yes |

A tier whose minimum term is 0 months charges no early closure fee on any closure, since no closure is dated fewer than 0 whole months after enrollment.

## Worked figures (hypothetical tier amounts)

1. A tier with an 18-month minimum term and an early closure fee of 415.00, closure after 9 whole months, no percentage relief: 415.00.
2. The same closure with reliefs of 6 and 9 percent: one rate of 15 percent; 415.00 reduced by 15 percent is 352.75.
3. The same tier, closure after 18 whole months: nothing is charged.
